The '''H6''' turbolaser was a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] emplacement weapon produced by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. The weapon was found on [[KonGar Ship Works]] [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]]s.
